name: vaultline-workspace
description: Repository root for Vaultline: the editor-agnostic detection engine (@vaultline/core, packages/core) and the two hosts that embed it — VS Code (packages/vscode-extension) and GitHub Copilot CLI (@vaultline/cli, packages/cli). The engine has no editor dependency, which is what made the second host a matter of implementing VaultlineHost rather than reimplementing detection.
//workspaces: Deliberately NOT an npm workspace. vsce resolves an extension's shippable files by running `npm list` in the extension directory, and inside a workspace npm answers for the whole repo — so vsce walks the entire tree and collects files from outside the package. Each package installs its own node_modules instead; scripts/setup.js does both.

scripts.//compile: Order matters: both hosts type-check against the core's emitted .d.ts, so the core builds first.
scripts.compile: npm --prefix packages/core run compile && npm --prefix packages/vscode-extension run compile && npm --prefix packages/cli run compile
scripts.package: npm run compile && npm --prefix packages/vscode-extension run package
scripts.package:platforms: npm run compile && npm --prefix packages/vscode-extension run package:platforms
